component.name: DeskUnion
component.summary: Mouse and keyboard sharing via LAN

description.p: Share one mouse and keyboard between computers on the same network.
Move the pointer past a screen edge to control the neighbouring computer. Traffic is encrypted with DTLS and devices are paired by certificate fingerprint.
Optionally stream a client's audio to the server and share plain-text clipboard contents between computers.

Captures the voices of Microsoft Teams calls on Windows. Windows hands the Teams desktop app no audio through the capture DeskUnion normally uses, so while Teams is playing DeskUnion now captures the output it plays on and goes back to normal afterwards. Also updates the Windows audio library, which fixes the lookup of an output chosen in the Audio page.

Retries the server connection the way Deskflow does, resolving the server name again on every attempt and showing the time left before the next one. Adds a tray menu with start and stop, connect and disconnect, reconnect now, a list of computers and shorter labels. Shows the round trip time of each connected computer in the connection list, stops capturing the pointer at the edge of computers that are offline, and makes the Windows cursor parking independent of the display scale.

Fixes clipboard text copied on GNOME not reaching Windows, publishes text copied on Windows immediately, and stops old Windows clipboard content from overwriting the peer. Parks the Windows cursor in the center of its display while another computer is controlled and returns it just inside the edge it left through. Also captures the Windows communications output so Teams call voices are heard, aligns the screen arrangement with the new design and ports lan-mouse fixes for libei session restarts and wlroots scrolling and keyboards.

Adds a tray icon on Linux (StatusNotifierItem, with Flatpak Background Apps support) and Windows so the window can be closed while DeskUnion keeps running, validates ports and fingerprints with explicit feedback, keeps unapplied client edits, lets a cancelled authorization be retried, reports audio startup errors in the banner, adds endpoint loopback selection for Windows audio capture and shows the application version in About.
Redesigns the screen arrangement as a compact numbered layout sharing one card with the client list, adds a persistent error banner, remembers the selected audio devices and tidies interface wording.

Closes the listener when the server is stopped so audio and connections end, fixes clipboard writes on Windows, and refreshes the interface: accessible names, confirmed deletion, a persistent error banner, remembered audio devices and clearer client rows.
Keeps remote mouse and keyboard input responsive while audio streams, shows the real connection state in the screen arrangement, and moves clipboard sharing to Settings.
Improves input-capture permission handling, audio test reliability, and cross-platform build support.

Clipboard sharing is now enabled by default and asks permission together with input capture. Clients announce their computer name to the server. The Connections page has a reworked screen arrangement canvas with keyboard support.
Adds opt-in plain-text clipboard sharing for Windows and GNOME Wayland, and Windows process-loopback audio capture that ignores master output mute and volume on supported builds.
Clearer client and server pages, a Connect button that starts sharing, and the Start/Stop button follows the system accent colour.
Ship the version in the Flatpak metadata so software centers detect updates.
Fix the Windows interface freezing when a connection attempt times out, and add a per-user Windows installer option.
